levels.hour: slow. TEMPLATE. the mold. the big form. what repeats a sitting.
levels.minute: middle. PRESENT. what is here. presence. the loaf in the room.
levels.second: fast. SHIFT. the 1 that flips. the bounce. the hop.

not.fourth: no millisecond religion. remainder is not a 4th hand.
not.fill: 0 unlocks. waiting is the common state. do not spin the second to prove we are live.

law: hour templates. minute presents. second shifts. three rates, one clock. if a fourth hand shows up we filled π.
pull: use the three levels on the dance. keep 0 as the unlock. do not add a tick.
